exposure: Before and during the COVID-19 pandemic
outcome: Hospitalization in neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
finding: Pregnancy complications, including hypertension disorder, gestational diabetes, placental abruption, pre-eclampsia, cesarean section, NICU admission, preterm birth, and hospitalization in other wards, increased during the COVID-19 pandemic compared to the pre-pandemic period.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates increased during the COVID-19 pandemic.
cross-section timing: February 18, 2019, to February 17, 2020, and February 18, 2020, to February 17, 2021
